'''Namarr''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In [[3642 BBY]] he was stationed on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] in the [[Tularan Marsh]], where he asked a fellow Imperial to dispose of Republic snipers threatening his position.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sergeant Namarr appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an NPC on Taris, who begins the mission "Trapped by Snipers".
